name: Rankioz SEO – AI Content Publishing & Meta Optimization
author: Nemanja Tanasković

sections.description:
Rankioz SEO connects your WordPress site to the Rankioz platform, enabling automated publishing of SEO-optimized content, meta tag management, and on-page optimization: all controlled from your Rankioz dashboard.

Rankioz analyzes your site using real Google Ads keyword data to find content gaps, then generates articles targeting those opportunities. This plugin is the bridge that lets Rankioz publish directly to your WordPress site.

What You Can Do

  • Auto-publish AI articles. Rankioz generates SEO-optimized articles (2,000–4,000 words) and publishes them directly to WordPress with proper formatting, categories, meta tags, and featured images
  • Manage meta tags. Update title tags and meta descriptions across your site from the Rankioz dashboard, with support for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and AIOSEO
  • On-page optimization. Apply Rankioz’s page optimizer suggestions (titles, descriptions) to individual posts, pages, or in bulk
  • Automated content pipeline. Set publishing schedules in Rankioz and articles go live on your WordPress site automatically
  • Works with popular SEO plugins. Seamlessly integrates with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and All in One SEO. Also works standalone if you don’t use an SEO plugin

How It Works

  1. Install and activate this plugin on your WordPress site
  2. Generate a secure API key in the plugin settings
  3. Paste the key into your Rankioz workspace settings
  4. Rankioz can now publish content, update meta tags, and optimize your pages remotely

Security

  • API key authentication on all requests (via X-Rankioz-API-Key header)
  • Only admin users (manage_options) can manage the API key
  • Nonce verification, capability checks, input sanitization, and output escaping throughout
  • No data is sent from your site to Rankioz: all communication is inbound (Rankioz calls your site)

Requirements

  • A Rankioz account (free plan available)
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Works well with

Publishing great content is half of answer engine optimization. The other half is making sure AI crawlers can read and cite your site: our free Rankioz AEO Toolkit plugin handles AI crawler access, llms.txt and schema in minutes. Use both and your content gets written, published, and found by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude.

Support

For support, visit rankioz.com or email us at hello@rankioz.com.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It stores a single API key (managed by site administrators) used to authenticate inbound requests from the Rankioz platform. No outbound data is sent.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory (search “Rankioz SEO”) or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/rankioz-seo/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Rankioz SEO in the WordPress admin sidebar
  4. Click Generate to create your API key
  5. Copy the key and paste it into your Rankioz workspace settings at app.rankioz.com

That’s it. Rankioz can now publish content and manage SEO for your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Rankioz account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Rankioz platform. You can start with the free plan at app.rankioz.com/register.

Does this replace Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No. Rankioz SEO works alongside your existing SEO plugin. When Rankioz publishes articles or updates meta tags, it writes to your SEO plugin’s meta fields (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, or AIOSEO). If you don’t use an SEO plugin, Rankioz can output meta tags directly.

Is my site data sent to Rankioz?

No. This plugin only receives requests from Rankioz: it does not send data out. All communication is inbound: Rankioz calls your site’s REST API using the API key for authentication.

What happens if I regenerate the API key?

The old key stops working immediately. You’ll need to update the key in your Rankioz workspace settings after regenerating.

Can Rankioz publish articles without my approval?

Only if you enable autopilot mode in Rankioz. By default, articles are created and require your review before publishing. You control the publishing workflow from your Rankioz dashboard.
